prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for sign_in reorder changes as only one test has been completed.
Evidence is still thin for home redesign changes as only one test has been completed.
Evidence is still thin for finish hint changes as only one test has been completed.
Predictions were consistently too high across all round 1 tests.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- finish, hint: -1.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, redesign: -2.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +2.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.6%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Stage layout pet companion showcase: Redesigns the friend picking screen into a dynamic stage layout with large pet previews and clearer choice cards. (why: Adoption has the highest drop-off rate in the funnel at 60.9% conversion with a long median time of 89s.)
1: [home, new_flow] Progress notification flow during rendering wait: Adds real-time status notifications and explicit time estimates while pet desktop assets generate. (why: The home/waiting step takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing uncertainty about app state.)
2: [choose_path, incentive] Path duration badges on creation choice screen: Highlights instant path vs custom path using spotlight layout and estimated setup duration badges. (why: Choose path screen drops 23.8% of users and takes a high mean duration of 514s due to decision friction.)
3: [adoption, wait_info] Photo upload quality checklist guide: Adds a checklist layout to photo upload screen detailing ideal lighting and angles for custom pets. (why: 3 support tickets specifically complained that custom pet generation fails or results look wrong.)
4: [home, notification] Desktop placement status notice on waiting screen: Displays explicit instructions on where the pet will spawn on the desktop screen during rendering. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on screen or app failing to launch visually after waiting.)
5: [finish, hint] Desktop controls quick reference hint: Adds quick interaction hint copy on the home intro screen detailing click and tray controls. (why: 3 support tickets reported confusion post-onboarding regarding how to interact with or hide the pet.)
6: [choose_path, copy] Desktop sanctuary intro text focus: Clarifies the core value proposition on the initial story screen with progress steps turned on. (why: Story screen decision time has a high mean (514s), indicating initial confusion about app purpose.)
